title: Activation runbook and autotuned probe chain for VPC post-deploy
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: provide an automated, repeatable activation runbook that executes a sequence of post-deploy checks for VPC/private deployments and dynamically tunes probe intensity based on observed capacity and SLOs. This ticket covers wiring Terraform outputs into the activation flow, an autotuning probe chain that scales probe concurrency and payload diversity, integration points with Console telemetry/dashboards, and safe rollback triggers for upgrade and initial deploy scenarios.

Background: We deploy Private (VPC) clusters via Terraform. After infra completes, customers need a predictable API readiness window and evidence that model processes can be instantiated and serve traffic at expected latency and throughput. Current ad-hoc smoke scripts are inconsistent across teams and sometimes overload cold hosts during large rollouts. We need a deterministic, low-risk activation process that: (1) validates control-plane + API handshake, (2) exercises model instantiate and KV cache warm paths with representative sequences, (3) ramps synthetic load to validate throughput targets, and (4) records telemetry and creates artifacts for postmortem or support.

Scope:
- Map Terraform outputs (LB/DNS, instance IDs, auth endpoints, kubeconfig/ssh credentials) into the activation runner so the flow is fully automated from apply -> activate.
- Implement a probe chain with phases: API handshake -> minimal generation smoke -> model load/instantiate validation -> KV cache correctness probe -> incremental throughput ramp -> stability soak.
- Autotune probe concurrency and sequence diversity using short feedback loops: if p95 latency below threshold and failure_rate < 0.5% for 60s, increase concurrency step; if failures or p95 spike, hold and/or scale down.
- Safety: cap max concurrency per host derived from inventory + runtime profile; use exponential backoff and circuit-breaker backstop; ensure a final gating boolean (activation_success) is exposed to CI and installer.
- Observability: emit events to Console with per-probe metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, model-init time, error codes), and generate a one-click failure triage link (logs + recent kernels + host metrics).
- Rollback triggers: if activation fails critical checks (API handshake, model instantiate) or sustained SLA breach during ramp, mark deploy as degraded and call configured rollback hook.

Non-goals: feature parity with full chaos testing or long-term soak beyond 30 minutes per activation run.
acceptance_criteria: Activation runner consumes Terraform outputs and resolves service DNS and admin endpoints automatically
API handshake check returns 200 + valid capability response within 10s for >99% of trials
Model instantiate probe completes for supported model variants (base, quant, int8) and records init_time <= configured threshold
Autotuned ramp can reach configured throughput target (tokens/sec) using incremental steps without exceeding safety caps
All probe metrics are visible in Console with links to the activation run artifact and a machine-readable JSON summary stored in the deployment state bucket
Failure conditions trigger a documented rollback hook and emit a high-priority alert to oncall with triage payload
tasks: Add Terraform output parser module and schema for activation runner (map lb_dns, api_port, instance_inventory, runtime_profiles)
Implement API handshake probe (auth, version, simple echo generation) and integrate with runner state machine
Create model instantiate probe with small representative prompts and verify KV cache hits on second pass
Build autotuning controller: stepwise concurrency adjustments, short-term telemetry windows, and safety caps per host
Wire metrics export to Console: activation_run_id, probe_phase, latency_percentiles, tokens_per_sec, error_classes
Add CLI/CI step to call activation-runner after terraform apply and surface activation_success boolean
Draft runbook docs and one-click triage link generator (logs + recent host-level metrics + PR/commit refs)
End-to-end test: run activation on a staging VPC with three model variants and validate acceptance criteria
